_PROVENANCE.purpose: Does a LEARNABLE differentiable spectral-index stem let the neural HydroViT learn the red-edge/band-ratio features the GBM uses, end-to-end, and match/beat the GBM on a grouped (station) holdout?
_PROVENANCE.architecture: LearnableSpectralIndexStem (softplus-mixed generalized normalized-difference indices, half literature-init half free) + small CNN + spatial-stats pool + MLP; LOG targets.
_PROVENANCE.chla_data: REAL Sentinel-2 L2A 6-band mc_tiles x REAL WQP in-situ chl-a.
_PROVENANCE.temp_data: REAL drone_wq_pairs.npz (4-band S2 x USGS in-situ Temp).
_PROVENANCE.split: STATION (site) GroupKFold OOF; inner grouped val early-stop.
_PROVENANCE.ci: site-clustered bootstrap (resamples sites, not rows), 2000 reps; paired delta-CI vs GBM. WIN requires delta CI to exclude 0.
